heading: I’m Ryan Elijah, and I’m running for Congress in Florida’s District 7.
text: For the past 14 years Ryan Elijah has been a very visible part of the community — building strong bonds with area leaders, giving him a unique position to bring your concerns and needs to the right people at the highest levels.

heading: Faith, family, and Central Florida.
text: Ryan and his wife, Tasha, have raised their two boys in Seminole County. As a long-time Florida resident of 20 years — 14 of them in District 7 — he is committed to fighting for conservative Florida values.

heading: Faith, family, and Central Florida.
text: Family is the foundation of our strong communities in Central Florida. Ryan is active in his church and believes in protecting family values.

heading: Endorsements
text: Ryan has earned the support of Florida’s governor, both of the district’s sheriffs, and members of Florida’s congressional delegation.

heading: Key Objectives

heading: Education

heading: The Military & Veterans

heading: Voter Action Center
text: Florida’s 7th District covers all of Seminole County and southern Volusia County. Here’s everything you need to cast your ballot for Ryan.

heading: Vote by Mail
text: Request your ballot from your county Supervisor of Elections, then return it by mail or to a secure drop-off location. Ballots must be received by 7:00 p.m. on Election Day — postmarks don’t count, so mail early.

heading: Vote Early
text: Skip the Election Day lines and vote in person at any early-voting site in your county. Dates, hours, and locations are set by each county Supervisor of Elections — confirm before you go.

heading: Vote on Election Day
text: Polls are open 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. Find your assigned precinct and polling place before you head out to vote for Ryan.

heading: Vote on Election Day
text: Not sure if you’re registered, or if you live in Congressional District 7? Check your registration status with the Florida Division of Elections.

heading: Key Objectives
text: As a public figure, Ryan Elijah has been immersed in the community and has heard your concerns. Once elected, he will bring them to those who can help get them addressed.

heading: Affordability & Economy
text: Congress must continue driving down costs for American families by keeping taxes low and achieving American energy independence. Lower gas prices are critical to our economy because they reduce costs for families, businesses, and everything we buy.

heading: Affordability & Economy
text: It’s past time to put a stop to out of control government spending that acts to drive up everyday costs for American families and our national debt.

heading: Affordability & Economy
text: Ryan understands that burdensome federal regulations will slow job creation and economic growth.

heading: Affordability & Economy
text: By unleashing the world’s best economy through lower taxes, less regulation, and smart growth, we will make America more affordable and prosperous for millions of Americans.

heading: Healthcare
text: Ryan supports solutions that deliver affordable, patient-centered healthcare options. He also believes healthcare costs can be reduced by providing individuals with tax benefits, such as expanded Health Savings Accounts.

heading: Healthcare
text: Additionally, Ryan supports greater transparency in the system, including requirements for clear pricing from hospitals, insurers, and other providers.

heading: Education
text: Ryan will strongly support our schools. His boys were educated in both public and private schools. He believes both are critical to our children’s success and our community’s future.

heading: Education
text: That’s why he champions parental rights and school choice, empowering families to make the best decisions for their kids and have transparency on curriculum.

heading: Education
text: Federal funding is important for the district, with the most recent audit showing Seminole County’s budget is comprised of nearly 14% federal funding, while Volusia County is closer to 20%. (National Center for Education Statistics, 2022/23 school year)

heading: Education
text: We must protect local control and ensure every dollar serves our students effectively.

heading: Faith, Family and Life
text: As your representative, he will champion policies that support parents, protect children, and keep families united and strong.

heading: Faith, Family and Life
text: Ryan is pro-life and believes every life is a sacred gift from God.

heading: The Military & Veterans
text: We must ensure that the U.S. military remains the strongest and best-equipped fighting force in the world, backed by the most advanced technology.

heading: The Military & Veterans
text: We must also guarantee that our veterans receive the best possible care after their service to our nation.

heading: Law Enforcement
text: Ryan is a strong defender of law enforcement and deeply understands the daily challenges officers face. He will strongly support legislation that protects law enforcement, including tougher penalties for assaulting or shooting officers.

heading: Law Enforcement
text: He is a staunch supporter of the Second Amendment and has earned an “A” rating with the NRA.

heading: Law Enforcement
text: Ryan has received multiple honors for his outstanding support of law enforcement.

heading: Illegal Immigration
text: We must continue to secure our borders and oppose any measures that weaken enforcement or prioritize non-citizens over American safety.

heading: Illegal Immigration
text: Ryan will work with local law enforcement to stop the flood of illegal drugs that damage our Central Florida communities.

heading: Illegal Immigration
text: He strongly supports the Save America Act, which ensures only American citizens can vote in our elections — because citizenship must matter.

heading: Privacy Policy.
text: How Ryan Elijah for Congress collects, uses, and protects your information.

heading: Introduction
text: Ryan Elijah for Congress respects your privacy and is committed to protecting it through our compliance policy. This policy describes the types of information we may collect from you or that you may provide when you visit the website, provide through online signups or in-person events, and/or subscribe to our mobile text services (collectively, the “Platform”) and our practices for collecting, using and maintaining, protecting and disclosing that information.

heading: Introduction
text: The policy applies to the information we collect:

heading: Introduction
text: In email(s), SMS/MMS text(s), and other electronic messages between you and Ryan Elijah for Congress;

heading: Introduction
text: When you provide it to Ryan Elijah for Congress through an online signup process or at an in-person event;

heading: Introduction
text: When you contribute to Ryan Elijah for Congress or purchase merchandise.

heading: Introduction
text: It does not apply to information collected by any third party, including through any application or content (including advertising) that may link to or be accessible from the Platform.

heading: Introduction
text: Please read this policy carefully to understand our policies and practices regarding your information and how we will treat it. If you disagree with our policies and practices, your choice is not to use the Platform. By accessing or using the Platform or signing up for services offered by Ryan Elijah for Congress, or continuing to use services offered by Ryan Elijah for Congress, you agree to this privacy policy. This policy may change from time to time. Your continued use of the Platform after we make changes is deemed to be acceptance of those changes, so please check the policy periodically for updates.

heading: Information We Collect and How
text: We may collect several types of information from and about the users of the Platform, including:

heading: Information We Collect and How
text: Information by which you may be personally identified, such as name, postal address, e-mail address, telephone number, and financial information you provide when making a contribution (“personal information”).

heading: Information We Collect and How
text: Information that is about you, but individually does not identify you, such as political affiliation, employment information (occupation and employer), demographic information, telephone carrier, and the date, time and content of your message, as well as other information that you provide.

heading: Information We Collect and How
text: All website users remain anonymous unless they choose to give us their personal information.

heading: We Collect This Information:
text: Directly from you when you provide it to us.

heading: We Collect This Information:
text: Automatically, as you navigate the site.

heading: We Collect This Information:
text: Automatically when you respond to e-mails or text messages.

heading: Information You May Provide to Us
text: The information we collect on the Platform may include:

heading: Information You May Provide to Us
text: Information that you provide by filling in forms on the Platform.

heading: Information You May Provide to Us
text: Information that you provide to comply with required campaign finance requirements at the federal, state, or local level, such as Name, Address, Occupation, and Employer.

heading: Information You May Provide to Us
text: Record and copies of your correspondence if you contact us.

heading: Information You May Provide to Us
text: Your responses to surveys, questionnaires, polls, or other data entry that we might ask you to complete.

heading: Information You May Provide to Us
text: Information you have provided to be published on the Platform. Your user contributions are posted on and transmitted to others at your own risk.

heading: Information We May Collect Through Automatic Data Collection Technologies
text: Information about your equipment and devices and internet connection, including your IP address, operating system and browser type.

heading: Information We May Collect Through Automatic Data Collection Technologies
text: We also may use these technologies to collect information about your online activities over time and across third-party websites or other online services (behavioral tracking). Technologies we may use for this automatic data collection may include:

heading: Disclosure of Your Information
text: We may disclose aggregated information about our users and information that does not identify any individual without restriction.

heading: Disclosure of Your Information
text: No personal information, including the phone number, is shared with third parties. Personal information collected should never be shared or sold.

heading: Email & Text Message Signups
text: E-mail: We appreciate your questions and comments about our Site and services and welcome your e-mails and questions submitted to our Site. We will share your messages with those within our organization who are most capable of addressing the issues contained in your message. We may archive your message for a certain period or discard it, but your e-mail address and message will only be used in accordance with this Privacy Policy.

heading: Email & Text Message Signups
text: Submitting your e-mail: Submitting your address anywhere on the site may result in your e-mail address being added to the Ryan Elijah for Congress e-mail list. You may unsubscribe to Ryan Elijah for Congress e-mails at any time by opting out of e-mail subscriptions with the “unsubscribe” link included in each e-mail. Your e-mail address will be removed from our marketing list. Please allow us a reasonable period of time in order to satisfy your request, as some promotions may already be in process.

heading: Email & Text Message Signups
text: Text Messages: Ryan Elijah for Congress will use your mobile phone number to send you text messages. These text messages will include news alerts, event notifications, voting reminders, and other similar updates. If you message us, we will share your messages with those within our organization who are most capable of addressing the issues contained in your message. We may archive your message for a certain period of time or discard it, but your mobile phone number and message will only be used in accordance with this Privacy Policy.

heading: Email & Text Message Signups
text: Submitting your mobile phone number: Submitting your mobile phone number to opt-in to our SMS program constitutes your express consent to receive autodialed messages from Ryan Elijah for Congress. Text STOP to opt-out. Text HELP for support. For further assistance, please e-mail Team@ElijahForCongress.com . Message frequency may vary. Message and Data Rates may apply. By opting-in, you agree to receive autodialed marketing mobile messages, and you understand that your consent to be contacted in this method is not required to make any purchase from us.

heading: Email & Text Message Signups
text: Opt-in consent applies only to Ryan Elijah for Congress or its successor entities and will not apply to any third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes.

heading: Accessing and Correcting Your Information
text: You may send us an email at Team@ElijahForCongress.com to request access to, correct, or delete any personal information that you have provided to us. We may not accommodate a request to change information if we believe the change would violate any law or legal requirement or cause the information to be incorrect. Colorado and California residents may have additional personal rights and choices.

heading: Accessing and Correcting Your Information
text: To learn more about California rights, visit https://oag.ca.gov/privacy/ccpa .

heading: Accessing and Correcting Your Information
text: To learn more about Colorado rights, visit https://leg.colorado.gov/bills/sb21-190 .

heading: Changes to Our Policy
text: It is our policy to post any changes we make to our privacy policy on this page with a notice that the privacy policy has been updated on the Ryan Elijah for Congress home page .
